digest.en: Israeli strikes hit Beirut, killing a senior Hezbollah commander, as US President Trump says a war with Iran would be 'over quickly'. India vows to crush terrorism a year after a conflict with Pakistan. Hantavirus patients are being evacuated from a cruise ship to Amsterdam.
digest.hi:
अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने अपने समर्थकों को भरोसा दिया कि ईरान विवाद जल्द सुलझ जाएगा। उन्होंने अमेरिकी कार्रवाई का बचाव किया। इस बीच, ईरान ने अमेरिका के 14 सूत्रीय प्रस्ताव को ठेंगा दिखाया।

इस्राइली प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने कहा कि वे ईरान पर हर स्थिति के लिए तैयार हैं। उनकी ट्रंप से रोज बात हो रही है। ईरान-अमेरिका वार्ता आगे बढ़ी है और युद्धविराम पर जल्द फैसला हो सकता है।

अमेरिकी सीनेटर मार्को रुबियो के बयान ने ईरान युद्ध पर अनिश्चितता बढ़ा दी है। उनके बयान और ट्रंप के बयान में विरोधाभास है।

articles.title: Trump says war will be ‘over quickly’ as Israel hits Beirut for first time since ceasefire
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump said the war with Iran would be over quickly after Israel launched airstrikes on Beirut for the first time since the ceasefire. The attacks targeted Iranian-backed Hezbollah militants in the Lebanese capital.

articles.title: India vows to crush terror 'ecosystem', a year after Pakistan conflict
articles.summary: India's government vowed to dismantle the country's terror ecosystem, a year after the conflict with Pakistan. The pledge was made by Home Minister Amit Shah in a speech to parliament.

articles.title: Moscow threatens to hit embassies if Kyiv disrupts Putin’s parade
articles.summary: Russia threatened to retaliate against Ukrainian embassies if Kyiv disrupts President Vladimir Putin's Victory Day parade in Moscow. The warning was issued by the Russian Foreign Ministry. Ukraine war live: Moscow threatens to hit embassies if Kyiv disrupts Putin’s parade The Independent.

articles.title: Man City manager Jeglertz always believed they could win WSL title
articles.summary: Manchester City manager Gareth Taylor's assistant, Camilla Jeglertz, expressed confidence in the team's ability to win the Women's Super League title. Jeglertz cited the team's strong squad and recent form.

articles.title: Malaysia’s SD Guthrie cautious on outlook after Q1 profit dips on weak palm prices
articles.summary: Malaysia's SD Guthrie saw its first-quarter profit decline due to weak palm oil prices. The company's revenue fell 12% year-on-year, with palm oil contributing to the decline. Malaysia’s SD Guthrie cautious on outlook after Q1 profit dips on weak palm prices.

articles.title: HSA takes down nearly 1,000 illegal health product listings; over 80% were for contact lenses
articles.summary: Health authorities seized over 6,600 items and took down nearly 1,000 illegal health product listings, mostly for contact lenses. More than 6,600 items were also seized during a two-week operation that was part of an Interpol-led global crackdown on illegal health products.

articles.title: Hazmat Suits On, Health Authorities Evacuate Suspected Hantavirus Patients From Cruise Ship
articles.summary: Health authorities evacuated suspected hantavirus patients from a cruise ship, with the WHO chief posting images of the evacuations. The WHO chief, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, posted images of the evacuations.

articles.title: Senior Hezbollah Commander Killed In Israeli Strike On Beirut
articles.summary: An Israeli strike on Beirut killed a senior Hezbollah commander during a meeting in the Ghobeiri stronghold. The strike hit a meeting of Radwan leaders in Ghobeiri, a Hezbollah stronghold (Representational).

articles.title: Hantavirus Has 38 Strains, Only 1 Spreads To Humans: New Updates In Atlantic Cruise Outbreak
articles.summary: The hantavirus has 38 strains, but only one spreads to humans, as seen in the Atlantic cruise outbreak. Atlantic cruise outbreak where one hantavirus strain is recorded to transmit from human to human.

articles.title: Hantavirus Patients Land in Amsterdam With More Cruise Ship Evacuations Planned
articles.summary: Three people with possible hantavirus symptoms were evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship in Amsterdam. Three people with possible symptoms of the disease were evacuated on Wednesday morning from the MV Hondius before it headed to the Canary Islands.

articles.title: New York judge makes alleged Esptein suicide note public
articles.summary: A New York judge made public a handwritten note allegedly written by Jeffrey Epstein, found after his first suicide attempt. The note's authenticity could not be verified. Epstein was a convicted sex offender.

articles.title: Trump takes another U-turn on Iran
articles.summary: US President Trump eased sanctions on Iran, allowing American companies to sell food and medicine to the country. The move comes amid ongoing diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran.

articles.title: "Watcha Want Me To Do? Bust Out Crying": Epstein Note Before Suicide Attempt
articles.summary: A note allegedly written by Jeffrey Epstein before his suicide attempt was discovered by a fellow inmate. The note reads "Watcha Want Me To Do? Bust Out Crying". Epstein was found on the floor of their cell.

articles.title: Bolivian police fire tear gas at protesting teachers
articles.summary: Bolivian police fired tear gas at protesters in La Paz, as teachers and other groups rallied against the government. The protests involved three separate groups. The police response was swift and forceful.

articles.title: Photo shows Israeli soldier desecrating Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
articles.summary: Israel's military launched an investigation after a photo showed an Israeli soldier desecrating a Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon. The soldier placed a cigarette into the statue's mouth. The incident sparked outrage and condemnation.

articles.title: How Hantavirus Usually Travels In Closed Spaces
articles.summary: Hantavirus typically spreads through contact with infected rodents or their droppings, and then to humans. In closed spaces, the virus can be transmitted through airborne particles, often resulting in severe respiratory symptoms. Early detection and treatment are crucial to prevent complications.

articles.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship leaves Cape Verde after three evacuated
articles.summary: The MV Hondius cruise ship, on which a British man and two others showed hantavirus symptoms, left Cape Verde after the patients were evacuated to the Netherlands. The ship had been docked in Cape Verde when the outbreak occurred. Authorities took swift action to contain the situation.

articles.title: Iran-US-Israel War News Live Updates: Iran expected to respond to US war proposal after Trump hails
articles.summary: Iran is expected to respond to a US war proposal after President Trump expressed optimism about a potential agreement. The situation remains tense as Iran considers the proposal. US officials are awaiting a response from their Iranian counterparts.

articles.title: Rubio to visit India for bilateral talks; Quad Foreign Ministers’ meeting May-end
articles.summary: Rubio will visit India for bilateral talks with Jaishankar, Doval, and Prime Minister Modi. Rubio will hold talks with Jaishankar and Ajit Doval, and call on Prime Minister Modi, in discussions that are expected to set the course for India-U. S.

articles.title: Argentina races to find origins of cruise ship hantavirus outbreak, amid reports some passengers
articles.summary: Argentina is investigating the source of a hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship, which departed from the country. Argentina has the highest incidence of hantavirus in the region, according to the WHO. Officials are working to determine if the country is the origin of the outbreak.

articles.title: A Hotel in Venezuela’s Capital Has Become the U.S. Embassy’s De Facto Headquarters
articles.summary: The J. W. Marriott hotel in Venezuela's capital has become a de facto headquarters for the US embassy, with diplomats, spies, and fortune seekers converging on the location. The unusual arrangement highlights the changing situation in the country. US officials are operating from the hotel.
